concerns.text: Task T015 (apply_galactic_mask) is marked [P] (parallel-safe) but has a hard data dependency on T014 (download_planck_map). T015 consumes the artifact 'Nside=2048 SMICA map' produced by T014. Parallel execution is impossible; T015 must strictly follow T014.
Task T016 (downgrade_resolution) is marked [P] but depends on T015's output ('masked_n2048.fits'). The [P] tag is incorrect as it implies no ordering constraint. T016 must follow T015.

Task T024 (compute_full_sky_cl) is marked [P] but explicitly depends on T019 (save_processed_map) and T023 (compute_alm). It consumes the 'processed map' and 'a_lm' artifacts. The [P] tag is invalid here.
Task T026 (compute_hemisphere_cl) is marked [P] but depends on T019 and T025. It requires the 'processed map' and 'hemispherical masks' as inputs. Parallel execution with T025 or T019 is impossible.
Task T032 (generate_isotropic_sims) is marked [P] but depends on T024 (full_sky_cl) and T019 (processed map). It consumes the 'best-fit C_l' and 'processed map' artifacts. The [P] tag is incorrect.

Task T033 (compute_hemispherical_variance) is marked [P] but depends on T032 (simulations) and T019 (observed map). It consumes simulation outputs and the observed map. Parallel execution is not possible.
Task T034 (build_null_distribution) is marked [P] but depends on T033. It aggregates the variance stats produced by T033. The [P] tag is invalid.
Task T035 (calculate_max_stat_pvalue) is marked [P] but depends on T034 (null distribution) and T033 (observed variance). It consumes the null distribution and observed stats. The [P] tag is invalid.
